title: Book 30 minutes with an architect
body: Not a discovery call with an SDR reading a script. You get one of the people who would actually scope and build the work, and you get a straight answer on whether we are the right fit.
agenda: Where the data sits today and what is blocking the use cases you want
What is realistically achievable on Snowflake, and in what order
A rough shape and range, or an honest no if the fit is wrong
reassure: No deck, no obligation, and no follow-up sequence you have to unsubscribe from.
ctaAria: Pick a time to talk to an architect (opens the scheduler)
facesLabel: The people who answer for the work
